# `codes.grow.packages:datadog-apm` — agent quickstart (Java 17+)

Ships inside the jar at `META-INF/grow/datadog-apm/AGENTS.md`
(`unzip -p datadog-apm-X.Y.Z.jar META-INF/grow/datadog-apm/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/datadog-apm/ · Service: Datadog APM · Categories: tracing ·
Package `codes.grow.packages.datadogapm`.

## Client

```java
try (DatadogApmClient client = DatadogApmClient.fromEnv()) { // GROW_DATADOG_APM_* > vendor env > defaults
  client.health();
}
```

Errors: `DatadogApmException` subclasses (`ConfigException`, `NotFoundException`, …) with `code()`.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/datadog-apm/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).
